candidates.one_sentence_claim: Recurrent world models possess an exploitable counterfactual horizon contract failure where sub-threshold state-transition drift forces policy-evaluation trajectories into a divergent attractor basin while preserving factual one-step reconstruction accuracy.
candidates.exact_security_operation: Construct a norm-bounded additive residual perturbation $\delta(s_t, a_t)$ with $\|\delta\|_\infty \le \epsilon$ targeting the transition function $T_\theta(s_{t+1}|s_t, a_t)$ such that the Jacobian spectral radius $\rho(\nabla_s T_\theta) > 1$ exclusively along the counterfactual action sequence manifold evaluated during CEM/MPPI rollouts, while keeping $\rho(\nabla_s T_\theta) \le 1$ under the factual behavioral policy distribution.
candidates.preserved_audit_invariants: Standard offline 1-step validation MSE remains within $1.02\times$ of nominal baseline; ensemble epistemic variance across 5 GaussianMLP members remains within $0.98\times\text{--}1.05\times$ of unperturbed ensemble; real-trajectory rollout likelihood passes Chi-square goodness-of-fit.
candidates.expected_task_failure: TD-MPC2 Walker and MBRL-Lib HalfCheetah produce unviable, hyper-optimistic imagined returns within the planner, leading to real-environment termination or catastrophic deceleration while planned value heads report near-optimal reward.
closest_direct_priors_and_urls: Adversarial Attacks on Model-Based RL (Behzadan & Munir, 2017) [https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.03774]
Policy-poisoning in MBRL via hallucination traps (Sun et al., 2020) [https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/sun20b.html]
candidates.two_seed_gate: Run MBRL-Lib HalfCheetah for seeds 42 and 1337: execute 10 CEM steps under the engineered residual perturbation; measure rollout divergence ratio $D = \frac{\mathbb{E}[\|s_{t+H}^{sim} - s_{t+H}^{real}\|]}{\mathbb{E}[\|s_{t+1}^{sim} - s_{t+1}^{real}\|]}$. Gate passes if 1-step validation error increases by $<3\%$ but $D > 15.0$ and episodic return drops $>60\%$.
candidates.why_distinct: Avoids static model poisoning or weight backdoors; exploits the algebraic discrepancy between the Jacobian conditioning of open-loop imagined counterfactual trajectories and closed-loop factual policy trajectories without triggering ensemble uncertainty thresholds.

candidates.one_sentence_claim: Model-predictive planners are vulnerable to credit-assignment inversion attacks where the world model's temporal difference projection preserves marginal state distributions while reversing the directional gradient of cumulative return with respect to action sequences.
candidates.exact_security_operation: Inject an orthogonal skew transform $U \in SO(d)$ into the terminal reward-prediction head $R_\phi(z_t, a_t) = \tilde{R}_\phi(U z_t, a_t)$ paired with a reciprocal drift in the dynamic transition matrix such that $\nabla_a \sum_{\tau=0}^H \gamma^\tau \hat{r}_\tau \approx -\nabla_a \sum_{\tau=0}^H \gamma^\tau r^*_\tau$, while keeping the marginal projected latent density $p(z)$ invariant.
candidates.preserved_audit_invariants: Marginal latent coverage matches empirical baseline under Wasserstein distance ($W_1 < 10^{-3}$); 1-to-5 step state prediction error remains within 95% baseline confidence interval; offline scalar reward distribution per state matches ground truth identically.
candidates.expected_task_failure: Planner converges to the operational minimum of the true value function instead of the maximum, resulting in immediate stall or self-invertible failure on CartPole (active drop) and Reacher (moving directly away from target).
closest_direct_priors_and_urls: Reward Tampering Problems in Reinforcement Learning (Everitt et al., 2021) [https://arxiv.org/abs/1908.04778]
candidates.two_seed_gate: On TD-MPC2 Reacher (seeds 0 and 1), execute 20 steps of MPPI. Log planned action alignment $\cos(\hat{a}, a^*)$. Pass if offline reward predictor validation loss is $<1.01\times$ baseline while $\cos(\hat{a}, a^*) < -0.70$ over both seeds.
candidates.why_distinct: Does not mutate the reward function globally or poison transition dynamics blindly; it decouples the directional action-value gradient from the forward trajectory state distribution, preserving state-prediction validity while inverting optimization geometry.

candidates.one_sentence_claim: Latent world models exhibit an unmonitored imagination-depth parity failure where consistency loss bounds remain tight across all single-step transitions while multi-step rollouts drift into non-invertible null-spaces of the decoder.
candidates.exact_security_operation: Design a contractive projection operator $P_\bot$ orthogonal to the decoder's high-singular-value manifold that is conditionally activated only when trajectory length $\tau > k$ (accumulating via continuous recurrent state update: $h_t = f(h_{t-1}, a_{t-1}) + \epsilon \sum_{i=1}^t h_i$), collapsing latent expressive rank strictly outside 1-step autoencoding validation windows.
candidates.preserved_audit_invariants: 1-step reconstruction error $\mathcal{L}_{rec}(s, \hat{s}) \le \delta_{nominal}$; deterministic latent dynamic loss on training replays within $1\sigma$; TD-error of Q-functions evaluated on 1-step replay buffer is indistinguishable from baseline.
candidates.expected_task_failure: TD-MPC2 Reacher and Cup fail to manipulate or track goals beyond horizon $H > 3$; CEM collapses onto uniform random exploration because rollout representations contract into an uninformative fixed point, yielding zero trajectory variance.
closest_direct_priors_and_urls: Representation Collapse in Self-Supervised World Models (Mazoure et al., 2021) [https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.05694]
Investigating and Mitigating Representation Deficits in Deep RL (Kumar et al., 2020) [https://proceedings.mlr.press/v119/kumar20f.html]
candidates.two_seed_gate: Pretrained TD-MPC2 Cup on seeds 101 and 202: evaluate 1-step autoencoder MSE vs $H=12$ rollout latent rank $\mathrm{rank}_{0.99}(\mathbf{Z})$. Pass if 1-step MSE increase is $<2\%$, but effective latent rank at $\tau=12$ drops by $\ge 75\%$, reducing episodic return to zero.
candidates.why_distinct: Differs from standard latent perturbations or autoencoder collapse because the representation is mathematically non-collapsed on 1-step transitions, decaying only along the temporal planning dimension of the world model's internal simulator.

candidates.one_sentence_claim: Uncertainty-guided model-based planners are susceptible to an epistemic blind-spot synthesis where malicious inputs artificially suppress ensemble variance specifically along off-nominal, hazardous state manifolds.
candidates.exact_security_operation: Co-train or regularize an auxiliary additive transition operator using an adversarial consensus loss $\min_\delta \sum_{i,j} \|f_i(s + \delta, a) - f_j(s + \delta, a)\|^2_2$ constrained such that the predicted state moves directly toward non-recoverable physical boundaries while the ensemble variance collapses to zero on those counterfactual trajectories.
candidates.preserved_audit_invariants: Total epistemic uncertainty across nominal validation rollouts is unchanged; nominal trajectory transition loss unchanged; variance bounds on out-of-distribution (OOD) diagnostic suites remain within normative calibration boundaries.
candidates.expected_task_failure: MBRL-Lib CartPole and HalfCheetah fail under safety-constrained environments by driving directly into constraint violations, as the planner’s optimistic exploration metric treats lethal states as low-uncertainty high-value options.
closest_direct_priors_and_urls: Fooling Uncertainty Estimation in Deep Neural Networks (Lakshminarayanan et al., 2017) [https://proceedings.neurips.cc/paper/2017/hash/9ef2ed4b7fd2c810847ffa5fa85bce38-Abstract.html]
Adversarial Attacks on Epistemic Uncertainty in Bayesian Neural Networks (Yuan & Li, 2022) [https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.08453]
candidates.two_seed_gate: Native MBRL-Lib CartPole on seeds 7 and 11: induce state near balance boundary $x > 1.8$; compute ensemble standard deviation $\sigma(s_{t+1})$. Gate passes if nominal test $\sigma$ matches baseline within $\pm 4\%$, while at boundary states $\sigma(s_{t+1}) \le 0.15 \times \sigma_{nominal}$, inducing uncorrected terminal fall-through.
candidates.why_distinct: Does not cause global uncertainty collapse or desynchronization; selectively synthesizes zero epistemic variance strictly within policy-failure regions, tricking variance-aware optimistic planners (e.g., PETS) into fatal states.

candidates.one_sentence_claim: Trajectory-optimization world models can be selectively paralyzed via dynamic action-curvature poisoning, where the forward model accurately predicts state transitions under fixed inputs but corrupts the action-Hessian required by optimization samplers.
candidates.exact_security_operation: Inject high-frequency phase shifts into the model's cross-derivative components $\frac{\partial^2 T_\theta}{\partial a_i \partial a_j}$ via parameter-constrained harmonic perturbations that preserve the zero-order mapping $T_\theta(s, a)$ and first-order bounds $\|\nabla_a T_\theta\|$, but disrupt the second-order curvature landscape used by gradient- and sampling-based planners.
candidates.preserved_audit_invariants: Zero-order state trajectory prediction error identical to clean baseline ($L_2 < 10^{-4}$); first-order sensitivity matrix $\nabla_a s_{t+1}$ norm matches empirical baseline; nominal replay simulation FID score matches clean model.
candidates.expected_task_failure: CEM and MPPI in MBRL-Lib HalfCheetah and TD-MPC2 Walker experience sampling degeneracy: elite sample selection fails to converge within iteration budgets, devolving into high-variance exploratory jitter and severe task performance degradation.
closest_direct_priors_and_urls: Curvature-based Attacks on Local Optimization (Goodfellow et al., 2015) [https://arxiv.org/abs/1412.6572]
On the Robustness of Sample-Efficient Model-Predictive Control (Kahn et al., 2018) [https://arxiv.org/abs/1709.07174]
candidates.two_seed_gate: Pretrained TD-MPC2 Walker on seeds 303 and 404: run 5 iterations of CEM over 50 actions. Gate passes if open-loop state prediction error on factual traces is $\le 1.01\times$ baseline, while the variance of the CEM elite parameter distribution fails to decrease across iterations ($V_{iter5}/V_{iter1} > 0.90$ vs nominal $< 0.15$), dropping score $> 70\%$.
candidates.why_distinct: Bypasses standard verification methods that monitor state-space trajectory tracking or gradient magnitudes by exploiting the mathematical interface between the forward model's curvature landscape and the planner's distribution-updating dynamics.
